Hi Sam / Maya — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers and what I can provide next: 

- SOC2 controls mapping: I’ll attach our controls matrix (CSV) that maps Cloud Security, Change Management, Access Controls, Logging/Monitoring, Incident Response to common auditor requirements. In the meantime, key points: centralized logging (immutable), 90-day retention by default (configurable), SIEM ingestion via syslog/forwarder.
- KMS: Dedicated capacity supports customer-managed keys through integration with customer KMS (AWS KMS + external HSM options). For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys, but Dedicated and Private can be configured to use your KMS/HSM.
- On-site/auditor requests: we accommodate auditor evidence requests under NDA; we provide a designated technical contact and can run controlled sessions with our security team.
- BAA: our standard draft covers PHI handling, breach notifications, and subprocessor protections. Common redlines are around data deletion SLAs and specific audit rights — we typically accept reasonable adjustments.

Next deliverables from Redwood (I’ll coordinate with Marissa):
1) SOC2 controls mapping (CSV) and redacted Type II PDF (sent).
2) Architecture note describing Dedicated KMS integration and network topology for Private deployments.
3) Proposed date slots for a 30-min security review call (I can do Wed 8/19 09:00-11:00 PST).

Marissa — I’ll drop the controls mapping and the Dedicated KMS note into the Drive link you shared.
